//: Model download catalog (read from the exe dir at startup). URLs and sha256 are pinned from the official sources below, checked 2026-11-13 via the HuggingFace API (lfs.oid = sha256 of the stored file): ggerganov/whisper.cpp (official whisper.cpp weights) and Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-GGUF (official Qwen GGUF). Do not add a model without a verified URL AND sha256 - the downloader refuses files that fail the hash. The optional display_name/language/license/notes fields feed the Models page; an old catalog without them still parses.

whisper.name: ggml-base.en.bin
whisper.notes: Fastest, English only. The classic default for dictation.

whisper.name: ggml-small.bin
whisper.notes: Handles Hindi and other languages; decent accuracy at a modest size.

whisper.name: ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin
whisper.notes: Best local accuracy for Hinglish (Hindi + English in one sentence) today; a cloud provider with codemix output can beat it - compare before committing to a default.

llm.name: qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf
llm.notes: Local cleanup model: fixes filler words and punctuation after transcription.
